items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: I thought 13th but no July 13th just a little bit younger than Bluey yeah

close right yeah but well he was lean and he looked a little frail you're right he was a small man but also uh if I remember right he also claimed that his birthday was on July 4th but I could be wrong I thought 13th but no July 13th just a little bit younger than Bluey yeah well yeah I remember that yeah but then of course we were we were 22 at the time yeah so I looked at it differently yeah
